name: keyed-ledgers-survive-reclone
title: Make every clone-local HMAC ledger declare key loss explicitly instead of regenerating a key silently
description: The B-8d60 investigation found that four sibling keyed ledgers (acceptance-basis-receipt, acceptance-rollout, pre-review-check, finding-ledger) store their HMAC key in the git common dir and regenerated a fresh key on 2026-08-31 after the 2026-08-30 re-clone. Their pre-clone records are now unverifiable but nothing reports that; unlike gap_log they do not fail closed, so a verifier can neither trust nor flag the old records. Apply the B-8d60 two-segment / explicit re-anchor pattern (or an equivalent key-epoch marker) to those ledgers so key loss is stated and auditable.
